result.official_quote: No landlord may evict or fail to renew any lease of any premises covered by section 2 of this act except for good cause as defined in section 2.
result.note: The citation drops the 'Anti-Eviction Act' name, which only the agency guide and a team note use, and the '-61.12' range, which no document states; it adds et seq. because the card merges the good-cause list (61.1), the nonrenewal bar (61.3), notice periods (61.2) and relocation (61.1g/61.1h), and cites the session law shown in the statute text.
